items.teaser: Alarm am Flughafen Leipzig/Halle: In der Nähe abgestellter russischer Antonow-Frachtflugzeuge wird ein Sicherheitszaun durchbrochen, mutmaßlich von einem Auto. Der Vorfall weckt Erinnerungen an einen versuchten Anschlag vor wenigen Monaten.

items.title: Rescue teams resume search for bodies under rubble after Russian strike on Sloviansk
items.teaser: In Sloviansk, efforts to recover bodies from under the rubble of buildings damaged by a Russian airstrike have resumed. The work had been suspended overnight due to security concerns.

items.title: Russian drones hit industrial facility in Volyn Oblast, causing major fire
items.teaser: Russian drones have struck an industrial facility in the settlement of Manevychi in Volyn Oblast, causing a major fire.

items.title: Rubio explains why Trump waived sanctions against Russia, says administration needs time to assess impact
items.teaser: Rubio said Trump has waived Graham Act sanctions on Russia for 60 days to assess their impact on global and US energy markets and tariffs on countries like India.

items.title: Drones strike oil facilities, Ozon warehouse and VKontakte data center in St. Petersburg
items.teaser: On the night of October 18 in St. Petersburg, a fire broke out at an oil terminal following a drone attack.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,565,060 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,090 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Russian forces launch massive attack on Rivne and surrounding area in early morning strike
items.teaser: Russian troops launched a massive strike on civilian infrastructure in Rivne this morning.

items.title: Russian forces attack Rivne again: fires break out
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched a large-scale attack on Rivne and its outskirts, targeting civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Region Sumy unter Angriff: Zwei Tote, fünf Verletzte
items.teaser: Infolge des feindlichen Beschusses sind in der Region Sumy binnen eines Tages zwei Menschen ums Leben gekommen.

items.title: Was hinter Trumps Kuschelkurs mit Putin steckt
items.teaser: Russland-Sanktionen ausgesetzt, stattdessen ein Diesel-Abkommen: Kurz vor den US-Zwischenwahlen nähert sich Trump Putin an. Die Ukraine schäumt. Was sind die Folgen der Kehrtwende?

items.title: Russian strikes kill two, injure five in Sumy region in one day
items.teaser: Two people were killed and five others injured in Russian attacks on the Sumy region over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russian online marketplace Ozon reports attack on warehouse in St Petersburg – photo, videos
items.teaser: Russian online marketplace Ozon said one of its St Petersburg logistics hubs was hit by drones overnight, sparking a fire; no employees were injured.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 2090 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 18. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.565.060 Soldaten. Innerhalb eines Tages wurden 2090 weitere Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region over 10 times overnight, injuring three
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 10 times since the evening, injuring three people.

items.title: ADF down 152 out of 180 drones used by Russia to attack Ukraine
items.teaser: Air defense forces neutralized 152 out of the 180 drones used by Russian forces to attack Ukraine since the evening of October 17.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,090 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 18, 2026, amount to approximately 1,565,060 personnel, including 2,090 troops over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with missile and 180 drones: 152 UAVs downed by air defence
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence shot down or jammed 152 out of 180 Russian drones overnight, but strikes were recorded at 20 locations, Air Force says.

items.title: By sending footage to enemy, people become tool in hands of invaders – CCD
items.teaser: Calls urging Ukrainians to send photos and videos of the aftermath of enemy drone strikes via a special chatbot in exchange for money are another trap set by the intelligence services of the aggressor state.

items.title: Three injured in Russian attack on Izium in Kharkiv Oblast
items.teaser: Three people were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Izium in Kharkiv Oblast on the night of 17-18 October.

items.title: Marco Rubio says Trump's Russian oil sanctions waiver is a '60-day pause,' denies restricting Starlink access
items.teaser: "I think the President wants to take the 60-day period of time to sort of analyze what imposing both sanctions and tariffs will mean to the global economy and even to the U.S. economy," said Rubio.

items.title: SSU charges five more Russian soldiers over killing of Ukrainian POWs
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has gathered evidence against five more Russian servicemen allegedly involved in the killing of three Ukrainian prisoners of war in Vovchansk, Kharkiv region, in the summer of 2024.

items.title: Critical infrastructure damaged in Russian air attack on Vinnytsia region
items.teaser: Critical infrastructure was damaged in a Russian air attack on the Vinnytsia region, while emergency power outages have been introduced across the region.

items.title: Russia loses 2,090 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 2,090 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Woman killed in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: A residential building in Zaporizhzhia was hit, a young woman was killed.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Poltava kills one, injures four
items.teaser: One person was killed and at least four others were injured in a Russian drone attack on Poltava, while private homes were damaged.

items.title: Trump calls decision to waive sanctions against Russia "very good" for US and "the world"
items.teaser: Trump said his decision to waive sanctions on Russia is "very good" for the US and the world, though he didn't specify what it entails.

items.title: Flames, explosions reported amid large Ukrainian drone attack on St. Petersburg
items.teaser: Eyewitness footage taken by St. Petersburg residents show what appears to be Ukrainian drones flying through the air and the city's air defense systems at work.

items.title: British, French and German troops to hold exercises in Poland simulating postwar deployment to Ukraine
items.teaser: Military personnel from Britain, France, Germany, and Poland will conduct joint exercises next month to rehearse a scenario involving the deployment of multinational forces in Ukraine following a possible ceasefire.

items.title: Russian attack damages critical infrastructure in Vinnytsia Oblast, causing power cuts
items.teaser: A Russian attack damaged critical infrastructure in Vinnytsia Oblast overnight, causing emergency power cuts.

items.title: Drones attack Russia's Leningrad Oblast: oil terminal on fire, power cuts reported
items.teaser: Over 100 drones attacked Leningrad Oblast overnight; the St Petersburg Oil Terminal caught fire and blackouts hit parts of the city, officials say.

items.title: Kromberg and Schubert electrical wiring plant in Lutsk halts operations following Russian attack
items.teaser: The Lutsk facility in northwestern Ukraine, which manufactures wiring systems for BMW, Audi, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, and Skoda vehicles, was attacked by Russian drones on Oct. 16.

items.title: Greece explains why it is not supplying Patriot missiles to Ukraine
items.teaser: Athens will continue to support Ukraine without compromising its own defense capabilities.

items.title: Magyar says Zelensky’s visit to Budapest later this month unlikely
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said he does not expect Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to visit Budapest later this month, despite Kyiv having received an invitation.

items.title: Trump administration proposes that Europe buy Russian gas, NYT reports
items.teaser: The administration of US President Donald Trump has proposed that Europe resume buying Russian gas.

items.title: Russians attack Zaporizhzhia apartment block: 27-year-old woman killed – photo
items.teaser: A Russian strike on a Zaporizhzhia apartment block has killed a 27-year-old woman and injured another woman and a six-year-old girl.

items.title: Ukraine charges Russian general who switched sides after occupation of Crimea
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has in absentia charged a military officer with high treason and desertion after he switched sides to Russia following the occupation of Crimea, was promoted to major general, and is now fighting against Ukraine as part of the Russian army.

items.title: Romanian F-16s down two jet-powered drones after airspace incursion
items.teaser: The two drones were jet-powered, belonging to the Geran-family of attack drones frequently used by Russia to attack targets in Ukraine, according to Romania's Defense Ministry. The Ministry did not specify which nation the drones belonged to.

items.title: Journalists identify names of over 281,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine
items.teaser: Journalists have identified 281,753 Russian military personnel killed since the start of Russia’s full-scale war against Ukraine, 15,721 more than were known two weeks ago.

items.title: Belgium’s 10 F-16s bring Ukraine’s promised fleet to about 100 jets. Fewer than 40 are flying, as Russia’s jet drones run them ragged
items.teaser: The rest arrive in batches through 2029, and every sortie against Russia's jet drones brings the jets already in Ukraine closer to long inspections abroad.

items.title: Russian missile strike on Kharkiv injures three people
items.teaser: Russian invaders launched a missile strike on Kharkiv, injuring three people.

items.title: Zelensky warns Russia may expand missile threats from Belarus against western Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukraine's State Border Guard Service spokesperson Andrii Demchenko has separately reported that equipment based in Belarus helps relay or amplify signals for Russian Shahed and Geran drones heading toward western Ukraine and Poland's border region.

items.title: Romanian fighter jets shoot down two drones over Black Sea
items.teaser: Two F-16 fighter jets of the Romanian Air Force shot down two drones on Saturday evening that had illegally entered Romanian airspace over the Black Sea.

items.title: Russlands Bedrohung für Deutschland: Wie groß ist sie?
items.teaser: Experten sehen Deutschland bisher militärisch und mental wenig vorbereitet auf russische Provokationen - und warnen vor der Vorstellung, ein Ende der Ukraine-Unterstützung würde Deutschland sicherer machen.

items.title: Pope speaks with Ukrainian woman before returning to Vatican from hospital
items.teaser: Pope Leo XIV left the Agostino Gemelli University Hospital in Rome on Saturday afternoon, October 17, and returned to the Vatican.

items.title: Air Raid Alert app now tracks movement of Russian drones and missiles
items.teaser: The “Air Raid Alert” app now features a map showing the estimated flight paths of enemy drones and missiles.

items.title: Rumänien schießt zwei Drohnen über dem Schwarzen Meer ab
items.teaser: Nach mehreren Angriffen auf Schiffe in der Region hat die rumänische Armee nach eigenen Angaben über dem Schwarzen Meer zwei Drohnen abgeschossen.

items.title: Ukraine hits Russian drone manufacturing plant in Rostov Oblast
items.teaser: Among the drones it produces are the Sarych, which uses video and thermal imaging equipment for surveillance, and the Klin, a loitering munition designed to strike targets, according to Ukraine's military intelligence agency.

items.title: Erneuter Vorfall - Kampfjets schießen Drohnen über Rumänien ab
items.teaser: In Rumänien hat die Armee zwei Drohnen über dem Schwarzen Meer abgeschossen.

items.title: Russian strike on energy facility in Chernihiv region leaves nearly 19,000 customers without power
items.teaser: In the Chernihiv region, nearly 19,000 customers were left without power due to Russian shelling of an energy facility.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russian forces launch another attack on energy facility in Ternopil region
items.teaser: An energy facility in the Ternopil region was struck again by a Russian attack.

items.title: Selenskyj kritisiert Trumps Aussetzung von Russland-Sanktionen
items.teaser: US-Präsident Trump setzt geplante Russland-Sanktionen aus - während Angriffe auf die Infrastruktur laut dem ukrainischen Staatschef Selenskyj zunehmen. Er warnt, Trumps Entscheidung werde Moskau nur weiter bestärken.

items.title: Russian attack causes power outages in Chernihiv district
items.teaser: A Russian attack has damaged an energy facility in Chernihiv Oblast, leaving approximately 19,000 consumers in the Chernihiv district without electricity.

items.title: Ukraine, EU set up joint task force to fast-track anti-corruption reforms that gate membership
items.teaser: Brussels and Kyiv will meet to grind through the anti-corruption reforms.

items.title: Umfrage der EU-Kommission zu den Exportkontrollpraktiken bei immateriellen Transfers von Gütern mit doppeltem Verwendungszweck (ITT)
items.teaser: Die EU-Kommission erarbeitet derzeit gemeinsam mit den EU-Mitgliedstaaten praktische Leitlinien zur Anwendung der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 mit Blick auf die Kontrolle immaterieller Transfers von Dual-Use-Gütern. Die Veröffentlichung ist bis Ende 2026 beabsichtigt.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell September 2026
18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen für den 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle sind ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Russian shelling in Dnipropetrovsk region injures three people
items.teaser: On October 17, Russian troops attacked the Dnipropetrovsk region more than 30 times, resulting in three people being wounded.

items.title: Russians attack energy facility in Ternopil Oblast again, causing power outages
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched another attack on an energy infrastructure facility in Ternopil Oblast, leaving some consumers in the Kremenets district without electricity.

items.title: G7 pledges 260 million euros to repair Chornobyl’s shield after Russia pierced it. Full repair will require 500 million euros by 2030, before corrosion sets in
items.teaser: Russian drone damaged the shield in 2025.

items.title: Russians attack critical infrastructure facility in Dnipro
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a critical infrastructure facility in the city of Dnipro on the evening of 17 October. Three people were injured in the Nikopol district over the course of the day.

items.title: Russian troops executed Ukrainian POWs in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, military says
items.teaser: The Russian soldiers are believed to belong to the 38th Separate Motorized Rifle Brigade, which is operating in the area. Kravchuk alleged that orders of this nature within the brigade are issued at the initiative of its commander, Colonel Valery Kazak.

items.title: Russian strikes on Kherson region leave one killed, 40 injured, including children
items.teaser: One person was killed and 40 others, including three children, were injured in Russian attacks on the Kherson region on October 17.

items.title: Ukraine cannot be forced to surrender, says commander whose brigade destroyed 57,000 Russian targets, as US pressure and Russian missiles test its will
items.teaser: Yurii Fedorenko of the Achilles brigade says the US turn toward Moscow may push Europe to arm Ukraine more.

items.title: Luhansk occupation authorities report large-scale power outages
items.teaser: Leonid Pasichnyk, the Russian-appointed head of the occupation authorities in Luhansk Oblast, has reported emergency power outages in Luhansk and 23 municipalities.

items.title: Rechtsruck - auch bei Israels linken Parteien?
items.teaser: Israels politische Landschaft ist über die Jahre nach rechts gerückt. Der Terroranschlag der Hamas vor gut drei Jahren hat diese Entwicklung verstärkt. Wie wirkt sich das auf linke Parteien aus? Von Jan-Christoph Kitzler.

items.title: Magyar says he has no objection to Ukrainian grain transit through Hungary
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said he saw no obstacles to the transit of Ukrainian grain through his country, responding to an earlier request from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Moldovan president: drones do not ask what language you speak
items.teaser: During the National Forum of Ethnic Minorities, Moldovan President Maia Sandu has recalled the incidents of drones crashing in the country, urging citizens to unite and support EU accession.

items.title: How one invented claim becomes a chatbot’s confident answer in cognitive warfare: Ukraine’s drone chief maps Russia’s AI attack
items.teaser: Russia floods AI chatbots with millions of fake articles so they repeat Kremlin narratives as fact

items.title: Burnt-out wreck: Ukraine destroys Smerch rocket artillery system that terrorised Kherson and Mykolaiv oblasts – video
items.teaser: Lasar's Group, a special forces detachment of the National Guard of Ukraine, has destroyed a Russian BM-30 Smerch launcher and its transporter-loader vehicle in Kherson Oblast.

items.title: Russian forces aim to capture Orikhiv by end of October, Ukrainian military says
items.teaser: Russian commanders have ordered their troops to capture Orikhiv, Preobrazhenka and Tavriiske in the Zaporizhzhia region by the end of October. However, Russian forces have been unable to establish a foothold in Orikhiv, and their reports claiming to have cleared the city of Ukrainian defenders are false.

items.title: Aktualisierung der Anhänge der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung
items.teaser: Mit der Delegierten Verordnung vom 14.09.2026 hat die EU-Kommission die Aktualisierung des Anhang I der Verordnung (EU) Nr. 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung) auf den Weg gebracht.

items.title: 18. Informationstag Exportkontrolle – Hinweis zum Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Anmeldungen sind ab 16. September 2026 möglich.

items.title: One killed and 37 injured in Russian attacks on Kherson in a single day
items.teaser: Russian forces launched airstrikes, artillery bombardments and drone attacks on Kherson Oblast on 17 October, leaving one person dead and 40 others injured, including 37 in the city of Kherson.

items.title: How big is Russia's threat against Germany?
items.teaser: Experts believe that, so far, Germany has been ill-prepared — both militarily and mentally — for Russian provocations. They also warn against the idea that ending support for Ukraine would make Germany safer.

items.title: Russian forces execute captured Ukrainian soldiers in Huliaipole sector
items.teaser: Law enforcement authorities have launched a pre-trial investigation into the execution of captured Ukrainian soldiers by Russian troops in the Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Erinnerung: Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO bis 11. September 2026
items.teaser: Vor einigen Wochen haben wir bereits per Newsletter über den Start der Umfragen zur Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-Verordnung informiert. Da der Start der Umfragen ausgerechnet in die Ferienzeit fiel, möchten wir Sie hiermit erneut an die Umfragen erinnern.

items.title: Förderkompass 2026
items.teaser: Schnell zur passenden Förderung – erstmals ausschließlich digital verfügbar.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell Juli 2026
Evaluation der EU-Dual-Use-VO
items.teaser: Wie in den vergangenen Monaten bereits angekündigt, hat die EU-Kommission den in Art. 26 Abs. 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2021/821 (EU-Dual-Use-VO) vorgesehenen Prozess zur Evaluation gestartet.

items.title: Zelensky: U.S. working to arrange possible meeting with Putin
items.teaser: The possibility of a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin remains under discussion.

items.title: Hungarian PM says he does not oppose transit of Ukrainian grain through Hungary
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has stated that he sees no obstacles to the transit of Ukrainian grain through Hungary following a request from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: He was found under rubble by colleagues: Ukrainian emergency worker killed in Russian strike on Donetsk Oblast
items.teaser: Anatolii Hopka, a 41-year-old rescuer with the State Emergency Service of Ukraine, has been killed in a Russian airstrike on a residential building in Sloviansk.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhstal steel plant with ballistic missiles, causing damage
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Zaporizhstal steel plant with ballistic missiles in the morning of October 17, damaging production facilities.

items.title: Nach Wappen-Sabotage - Löwen-Boss kritisiert Bayern wegen Anzeige
items.teaser: Gernot Mang, Präsident des TSV 1860 München, kritisiert bei BILD den FC Bayern.

items.title: Kromberg & Schubert plant in Lutsk halts operations following Russian strikes
items.teaser: The Kromberg & Schubert plant in Lutsk, which manufactures onboard electrical cable systems for cars, has suspended operations following Russian strikes on the facility.

items.title: Putin wants to deploy ballistic missiles in Belarus to attack western Ukraine, Zelensky says
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky said signal repeaters are operating in Belarus to help Russian drones reach western Ukraine, but Vladimir Putin wants to go further and deploy ballistic weapons in Belarus.

items.title: Vorankündigung des 18. Informationstags Exportkontrolle
items.teaser: Der Informationstag Exportkontrolle (ITE) wird am 10. Dezember 2026 in Frankfurt am Main stattfinden.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag in Berlin eröffnet
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag ist heute in Berlin eröffnet worden. Unter dem Leitthema „Exportkontrolle in der Balance?“ diskutieren heute und morgen Vertreterinnen und Vertreter aus Politik, Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und internationalen Partnerorganisationen aktuelle Entwicklungen der Exportkontrolle.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell Juni 2026
Exportkontrolle Aktuell April 2026
Ukraine's General Staff confirms strike on Russian drone plant in Rostov Oblast – photo
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff has confirmed a strike on the Roboavia plant in Russia's Rostov Oblast, which manufactures UAVs for the Russian military.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukrainian and U.S. negotiating teams may meet next week
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said the Ukrainian and U.S. negotiating teams may meet next week.

items.title: Zelenskyy: neither US nor Russia has confirmed possible meeting with Putin in Miami
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says a trilateral meeting between the leaders of Ukraine, the US and Russia has been proposed for the G20 summit in Miami in December, but is not yet confirmed.

items.title: Russia may seek to get back frozen assets through Ukraine's partners, Zelensky says
items.teaser: "Today, this is fully under Europe's control. That means (Russian frozen assets) are safe for now," President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Anmeldestart
items.teaser: Die Anmeldung zum Exportkontrolltag ist ab sofort möglich.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine needs more Patriot missiles from Europe now as new interceptor plans take shape
items.teaser: Ukraine currently needs a package of PAC-2 and PAC-3 missiles from Europe and some other countries, after which the FREYJA antiballistic program will come into operation and contracts with Germany to purchase the relevant interceptors will take effect.

items.title: Europeans are working on Starlink alternative and will succeed, Zelenskyy says
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that European countries are developing an alternative to Starlink after seeing how the US can restrict its operations.

items.title: Ukraine loses ability to use Starlink to shoot down jet-powered Shaheds – Zelensky
items.teaser: Starlink service in Ukraine is being limited to a speed of 161 km/h, making it impossible to use the system on interceptors targeting jet-powered Shaheds.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Russia wants to deploy ballistic missile systems in Belarus to attack Ukraine's west
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that Russia intends to deploy ballistic missile systems in Belarus to attack the western part of Ukraine.

items.title: Over half of Russian jet-powered drones downed by Ukraine's aircraft, Zelensky says
items.teaser: Ukraine has secured contracts and assurances from partners on additional supplies of F-16 ammunition, Zelensky noted, adding that the current deliveries were at a "satisfactory level."

items.title: Commanders from Azov, Marines, and 93rd tell Ukraine’s defense minister what front needs. He wants their methods scaled to other units
items.teaser: The goal, he says, is to keep soldiers alive.

items.title: Zelenskyy on risks of Russian assets in Europe being unfrozen: Europeans have situation under control
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has commented on the risks of Russia attempting to reclaim its frozen assets in Europe, stating that the EU currently has the situation completely under control.

items.title: Participation in EU security architecture also guarantees Ukraine’s security – Mathernová
items.teaser: Integration into the EU structures and participation in its security architecture would be among the best security guarantees for Ukraine.

items.title: Flights cancelled at Moscow airports for second consecutive night due to drone attacks
items.teaser: Moscow airports once again introduced restrictions on the arrival and departure of flights on the evening of 16 October and the night of 16-17 October due to the threat of Ukrainian drone attacks. Over 350 flights were delayed or cancelled, most of them at Sheremetyevo.

items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike Russian drone facility, missile brigade supply depot
items.teaser: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine confirmed that Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck the Roboavia drone development and manufacturing facility in Russia’s Rostov region and a logistics depot belonging to a Russian missile brigade in the Bryansk region.

items.title: Zelenskyy notes improvement in Ukrainian-Polish relations
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that relations between Ukraine and neighbouring Poland have improved recently, emphasising that both countries share a common enemy in Russia.

items.title: Sweden to provide Ukraine with €45m, including for energy
items.teaser: Sweden has announced a new €45 million support package for Ukraine, with a portion of the funds directed towards repairing power grids and restoring heat supply.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Anmeldestart am 15. April 2026
items.teaser: Hinweise zum Anmeldestart

items.title: Mathernová outlines how EU is helping Ukraine prepare for winter
items.teaser: The European Union is providing Ukraine’s energy sector with a range of support to improve its readiness for winter amid Russian strikes on Ukraine’s critical infrastructure.

items.title: 'Putin feels joy' — Zelensky calls Trump's waiving of key Russia sanctions 'wrong'
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on oct. 17 U.S. President Donald Trump was "wrong" to further "block" sanctions against Russia, while expressing hope that he would do "everything possible" to stop the full-scale war.

items.title: "Nationales Interesse" - Trump setzt geplante Sanktionen gegen Russland aus
items.teaser: Erst macht der US-Präsident einen umstrittenen Diesel-Deal mit Russland, nun setzt Trump gerade erst beschlossene Sanktionen aus. Das Weiße Haus begründet dies mit nationalem Interesse. Moskau reagiert erfreut, die Ukraine ist entsetzt.

items.title: Russians have executed Ukrainian soldiers in Zaporizhzhia Oblast, Ukrainian forces say
items.teaser: Russian forces from the 38th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade have executed Ukrainian prisoners of war on the Huliaipole front in Zaporizhzhia Oblast

items.title: Azov Regiment denies Russian claims of capturing three settlements near Dobropillia
items.teaser: The 1st Corps of the National Guard “Azov” has refuted Russian claims regarding the alleged capture of Zolotyi Kolodiazh, Novotroitske, and Petrivka in the Donetsk region.

items.title: Zelenskyy on Starlink operations: test in EU has proved restrictions apply only in Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has stated that a test conducted in the European Union has proved that Starlink speed limits apply only in Ukraine, calling it a planned operation.

items.title: 'Planned operation' — Zelensky confirms Ukraine's Starlink access not fully restored
items.teaser: Zelensky called the restrictions a "planned operation" targeting Ukraine, noting that Starlink speed limits remain in effect in Ukraine but not in EU countries.

items.title: Generalstab weist die russischen Behauptungen über „Erfolge“ an der Front zurück
items.teaser: Der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte hat die Behauptungen des russischen Kommandos zurückgewiesen, wonach seit dem 1. September angeblich mehr als 1.800 Quadratkilometer ukrainisches Territorium und 92 Ortschaften eingenommen worden seien.

items.title: Zelenskyy on Trump's decision: Diesel Deal is first step, lifting of Russia sanctions will continue
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says that Russia sanctions relief and restrictions on Ukraine's ability to respond to Russian attacks would not stop Vladimir Putin and could instead embolden him to continue the war.

items.title: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.

items.title: Zelensky: Russian forces attack more than 15 energy facilities
items.teaser: From 7:00 p.m. on October 16 until Saturday morning, the Russians launched more than 320 drones of various types, as well as loitering munitions, cruise missiles, and ballistic missiles, at Ukraine’s energy infrastructure.

items.title: Russians attack Zaporizhstal for fifth time, firing six ballistic missiles – photo
items.teaser: Russia has attacked the Zaporizhstal steelworks for the fifth time, firing six ballistic missiles at its energy, logistics and production facilities.

items.title: Ausfuhrkontrolle: Bundesregierung vereinfacht Ausfuhr von bestimmten Rüstungsgütern an die Golfstaaten und die Ukraine
items.teaser: Die befristete Allgemeine Genehmigung für die Lieferung von Gütern der Luft- und maritimen Verteidigung ist zum 20. März 2026 in Kraft getreten.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: Congress gave Trump 30 days to hit Russia’s oil buyers with 100% tariffs. He waives them two days before deadline, citing US interests. Moscow calls it historic
items.teaser: Moscow called the reversal historic.

items.title: Slovak PM says Slovakia and Hungary will not fund EU aid for Ukraine in 2027
items.teaser: Slovak PM Robert Fico says Slovakia and Hungary will not participate in an EU initiative to provide Ukraine with an additional €70 billion in financial support for 2027.

items.title: 20. Exportkontrolltag – Save The Date
items.teaser: Der 20. Exportkontrolltag findet im Juni in Berlin statt.

items.title: Selenskyj: Die Russen greifen mehr als 15 Energieanlagen an
items.teaser: Vom 16. Oktober um 19:00 Uhr bis zum Samstagmorgen feuerten die Russen mehr als 320 Drohnen verschiedener Typen sowie Loitering-Munition, Marschflugkörper und ballistische Raketen auf die Energieinfrastruktur der Ukraine ab.

items.title: Ukraine's Armed Forces refute Russian claims of advance towards Zaporizhzhia and capture of Kostiantynivka and Dobropillia
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has refuted claims by Valery Gerasimov, Chief of the General Staff of the Russian Armed Forces, that Russian forces have captured 92 settlements since early September, including Kostiantynivka and Dobropillia, and advanced to within 5 kilometres of the outskirts of Zaporizhzhia.

items.title: Russian attack on Kherson kills one person, injures 22 others
items.teaser: One person was killed and 22 others were injured in Kherson this morning as a result of a Russian airstrike.

items.title: Russian Ryazan oil refinery halts operations of one main unit after drone attack, Reuters reports
items.teaser: Since President Volodymyr Zelensky announced the resumption of strikes on Oct. 15, Kyiv has not reported any new attacks on Russian oil refineries or confirmed reports of such strikes.

items.title: "Time to say goodbye": protest calling for mayor's resignation held on Khreshchatyk – photos
items.teaser: A protest calling for the resignation of Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko is taking place on Khreshchatyk Street outside the Kyiv City State Administration building on Saturday 17 October.

items.title: Russian forces launch massive guided bomb attack on Sumy, killing one person and injuring several others
items.teaser: Russian invaders launched a massive strike with guided bombs on Sumy; one man was killed and two others were injured.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 238 Gefechte an der Front, die Richtung Pokrowsk nach wie vor die heißeste
items.teaser: Am 14. Oktober kam es zu 238 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front.

items.title: "Sanctions blackout": Zelenskyy says "Graham Act" has been completely ignored
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has described the lifting of sanctions against Russia under the so-called Graham Act, signed by US President Donald Trump, as a "sanctions blackout". However, he believes the legislation could still put pressure on Russia.

items.title: Russian FAB bombs hit high-rise buildings in Sloviansk, killing one person and injuring ten others
items.teaser: In Sloviansk, Russian troops dropped a FAB bomb on a residential area. One person was killed and ten were wounded.

items.title: Polish military to practise deploying forces in Ukraine in event of ceasefire with Russia – media
items.teaser: According to The Times, 1,500 European troops will practise deploying forces to Ukraine in Poland in November in preparation for a possible ceasefire with Russia.

items.title: Russians attack industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked an industrial facility in Kryvyi Rih on the night of 16-17 October.

items.title: Vinnytsia region endures one of Russia's largest attacks since start of full-scale invasion
items.teaser: The Vinnytsia region has suffered one of the most intense attacks since the start of the full-scale invasion. As a result of the enemy strikes, civilian and critical infrastructure was damaged, and six people were injured.

items.title: Trump zu Starlink-Drosselung: "Das habe ich nicht getan"
items.teaser: Die USA zeigen der Ukraine, wer am längeren Hebel sitzt - doch hinterher will es niemand gewesen sein. Russland profitiert in seinem Angriffskrieg militärisch von der Einschränkung des Satelliten-Internets.

items.title: Angriff auf Cherson: Ein Todesopfer, 22 Verletzte
items.teaser: In Cherson kam am Morgen des 17. Oktober infolge eines russischen Luftangriffs eine Person ums Leben, 22 Menschen, darunter zwei Kinder, wurden verletzt.

items.title: Slovakia, Hungary won't join 70 billion euro EU package sought by Ukraine, Fico says
items.teaser: Zelensky asked EU leaders for an additional 70 billion euros to help cover Ukraine's defense and "resilience" needs in 2027, as Kyiv grapples with a budget shortfall amid escalating Russian attacks.

items.title: Third Corps shows footage of first strike on Russia’s new "Dragon" thermobaric weapon system
items.teaser: Soldiers from the 3rd Army Corps have struck a Russian TOS-3 Drakon (Dragon) thermobaric rocket launcher system for the first time. The system was hit by a drone.

items.title: Drone attacks on Moscow continue since last night
items.teaser: On the night of October 17, Moscow was attacked by 144 drones, prompting the Russian capital’s airports to impose restrictions, and causing flights to be delayed and rerouted.

items.title: Russland-Sanktionen auf Eis: Wie sich Trump Putin weiter annähert
items.teaser: Die Unterstützung von US-Präsident Trump für die Ukraine war schon immer zurückhaltend. Mit den jetzt gestoppten Sanktionen kommt er dem russischen Präsidenten weit entgegen. Auch in den USA wird er dafür massiv kritisiert. Von Carsten Kühntopp.

items.title: Russians strike Sumy and Sumy Oblast with guided bombs: residential area hit, two injured – photos
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Sumy and Sumy Oblast with guided aerial bombs on Saturday morning, hitting a residential area and injuring two people.

items.title: Russian forces drop eight bombs on Kherson, killing one person and injuring 20 others
items.teaser: In Kherson, 20 people have already been wounded as a result of this morning’s airstrike on a residential area: the enemy dropped eight bombs.

items.title: 2026 Australian Arbitration Week Recap: It's Not Me, It's You. Repudiatory Breach of the Arbitration Agreement, English and Australian Law
items.teaser: Contractual parties sometimes attempt to manipulate a counterparty into a repudiatory breach of the arbitration agreement, often as a means of exiting an unfavourable contract. items.title: Welche Drohnen Satelliteninternet brauchen
items.teaser: Störungen bei Starlink haben ukrainische Drohneneinsätze beeinträchtigt. Welche Drohnen Satellitenverbindungen brauchen - und welche ohne sie auskommen.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert vier “Kalibr“-Raketen und 289 Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat vier Raketen vom Typ Kalibr und 289 Drohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Freitagabend, dem 16. Oktober, das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Russian forces attack Dnipropetrovsk region, killing one person
items.teaser: Russian forces launched nearly 20 attacks on three districts of the Dnipropetrovsk region over the past day, using missiles and drones, killing one person.

items.title: Trump would welcome Putin to G20 summit in US but unsure if he will attend
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump told reporters that he does not yet know whether Russian ruler Vladimir Putin will attend the G20 summit in Miami at the invitation of the United States, although he "certainly would love to have him [at the G20]".

items.title: Russian attacks kill 7, injure dozens across Ukraine amid continued strikes on energy infrastructure
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces downed 289 out of the 332 drones, including jet-powered attack drones, launched by Russia overnight, the Air Force reported. Russian drones and ballistic missiles of the Iskander-M or the North Korean KN-23 model struck 22 different locations, and debris fell in three areas.

items.title: Selenskyj fordert weitere 70 Milliarden Euro von der EU - News kompakt: Das Wichtigste kurz gefasst
items.teaser: Die Ukraine benötigt mehr Geld, um sich gegen die russischen Angriffe zu wehren. Donald Trump legt die geplanten Sanktionen gegen Russland auf Eis. Der DW-Nachrichtenüberblick.

items.title: News kompakt: Selenskyj fordert 70 Milliarden Euro von der EU
items.teaser: Die Ukraine benötigt mehr Geld, um sich gegen die russischen Angriffe zu wehren. Donald Trump legt die geplanten Sanktionen gegen Russland auf Eis. Der DW-Nachrichtenüberblick.

items.title: Hundreds of thousands of people without electricity in Zhytomyr Oblast after Russian attack
items.teaser: Energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr Oblast has come under a Russian attack, resulting in a large-scale power outage.

items.title: Two people injured in Russian strike on enterprise in Rivne region
items.teaser: Two people were injured when Russian forces struck an enterprise in the Rivne region.

items.title: Italy calls US weakening of Ukraine a "major mistake", says Putin cannot be stopped this way
items.teaser: Italian Defence Minister Guido Crosetto has said that the US decision to restrict Ukraine's access to satellite systems and intelligence used to defend itself against Russian attacks is a "complete mistake, a major mistake".

items.title: U.S. lawmakers introduce bill to block Trump’s Russia diesel deal
items.teaser: On October 16, Gregory Meeks, Ranking Member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, introduced a bipartisan bill aimed at blocking President Donald Trump’s deal with Vladimir Putin to purchase and import Russian diesel fuel.

items.title: Ukraine’s ADF down four Kalibr missiles, 289 drones in overnight Russian attack
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defense forces neutralized four Kalibr cruise missiles and 289 drones launched by Russian forces in an attack that began in the evening of October 16.

items.title: Trump setzt im „Graham-Gesetz“ vorgesehene Sanktionen gegen Käufer russischer Energieträger aus
items.teaser: Trump setzte Sanktionen gegen Käufer russischer Energieträger aus, die im Graham-Gesetz vorgesehen sind.

items.title: Vinnytsia hit by blackout after Russian attack
items.teaser: Vinnytsia has been left without electricity following a Russian strike, the city is switching to backup power sources.

items.title: Exclusive: Watchdog lists ships carrying Russian gas, blasts Trump sanctions waiver
items.teaser: "Republicans and Democrats passed this law in Lindsey Graham's name to squeeze Russia's war revenues. Trump has now hollowed it out before its main sanctions could bite," said Alexander Kirk, a sanctions campaigner at Urgewald.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,562,970 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,950 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: War update: 238 clashes on front line over past day, Pokrovsk sector remains hottest
items.teaser: A total of 238 combat engagements between Ukraine’s Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on October 16.

items.title: Russian aerial bomb strike on Sloviansk destroys apartment buildings, killing one and injuring 10 – video
items.teaser: Russian forces struck two high-rise residential buildings in Sloviansk, Donetsk Oblast, at 03:40, partially destroying both buildings. Rescue workers are searching the rubble for people who may be trapped beneath it.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1950 weiteren Angreifern und drei Luftabwehrsystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 17. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.562.970 Soldaten. Innerhalb eines Tages wurden 1880 weitere Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,950 over past day
items.teaser: Russia’s total combat personnel losses since the start of its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to October 17, 2026, stand at approximately 1,562,970, including 1,950 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with Iskander, Kalibr and Kh-22/32 missiles and over 300 drones: air defences downs 293 aerial assets
items.teaser: Russia launched ballistic and cruise missiles and 332 attack drones overnight. Ukraine's air defences destroyed 293 aerial assets, while impacts were recorded at 22 locations.

items.title: Russian missile strikes injure 15 people in Kharkiv
items.teaser: Fifteen people, including three children, were injured in Russian missile strikes on Kharkiv in the evening of October 16.

items.title: Russians attack Pokrovsk and two other fronts over 70 times – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine’s General Staff reports 238 combat clashes over the past day, with the heaviest Russian attacks on the Kupiansk, Kostiantynivka and Pokrovsk fronts.

items.title: Closing loopholes: Council lists individuals and entities for circumventing EU sanctions
items.teaser: The Council has adopted restrictive measures against three individuals and nine entities involved in the import of sanctioned goods to Russia, and in the circumvention of sanctions related to oil and financial transactions.

items.title: German expert: Europe must stand up to Trump and continue supporting Ukraine and Zelensky
items.teaser: European countries should clearly state their readiness to continue supporting Ukraine and its elected President Volodymyr Zelensky, even if this means openly disagreeing with U.S. President Donald Trump.

items.title: Russian large-scale attack on Kharkiv: number of people injured rises to 15 – photos
items.teaser: Emergency services report that a Russian attack on Kharkiv on the evening of 16 October damaged residential buildings and other facilities, sparking four fires. The number of injured has risen to 15.

items.title: Russian attack leaves Vinnytsia without power
items.teaser: Vinnytsia Mayor Serhii Morhunov says the damage is being assessed following Russian strikes. Critical infrastructure is operating on backup power and additional buses and minibuses will replace electric public transport.

items.title: Trump suspends sanctions on buyers of Russian energy under Graham Act
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has suspended the implementation of tariffs and sanctions provided for under the Lindsey Graham Act, which was passed in September.

items.title: Family with infant injured in morning airstrike in Kherson, another person killed
items.teaser: A family with a one-month-old infant was injured in a morning airstrike in Kherson, while an emergency medical services driver was also killed.

items.title: Macron responds to Le Pen: Ending aid to Ukraine would jeopardize France’s security
items.teaser: French President Emmanuel Macron criticized far-right leader Marine Le Pen’s statements that she intends to end financial support for Ukraine if she comes to power, stressing that assisting Kyiv serves France’s national interests and that abandoning such support would mean neglecting the security of the French people a

items.title: Russia loses 1,950 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,950 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: Trump setzt geplante Sanktionen gegen Russland aus
items.teaser: US-Präsident Donald Trump hat mehrere Sanktionen kurz vor Inkrafttreten ausgesetzt. Das Gesetz sollte unter anderem den Kreml wegen des Ukraine-Kriegs stärker unter Druck setzen.

items.title: Russian airstrikes on Kherson kill ambulance driver and injure civilians, including children
items.teaser: A 64-year-old emergency medical services driver has suffered fatal injuries following Russian airstrikes on Kherson. Thirteen people have been injured.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia hit by several missile strikes, homes damaged, casualties reported
items.teaser: Zaporizhzhia came under several missile strikes, damaging residential buildings and leaving at least two people injured.
